walkthroughs.body_html:
When you feel threatened, your body goes fight or flight:

  • Heart races.
  • Breath quickens.
  • Muscles tense.
  • Adrenaline floods in.

Great if you spot a tiger. Less great before an exam. 🐅

Short bursts help you perform.

Long-term stress (high cortisol) hurts sleep, mood and the immune system.

Coping tips that work:

  • Slow, deep breaths.
  • Talk to someone.
  • Exercise — even a walk.
  • Plan and break big tasks down.
  • Sleep well.

Stress isn't bad — but management is everything. 🧘
